name: Rose Velvet Lipstick
description: A creamy, long-wearing lipstick in a soft rose tone with a velvet matte finish. Infused with shea butter for hydration that lasts.

name: Hydra Glow Serum
description: A lightweight hyaluronic acid serum that plumps and hydrates skin for an immediate glow. Suitable for all skin types.

name: Midnight Bloom Eau de Parfum
description: An intoxicating floral fragrance with notes of jasmine, oud, and black amber. Designed for evening wear.

name: Silk Foundation
description: A medium-coverage liquid foundation with a satin finish. Buildable, breathable, and available in 30 shades.

name: Charcoal Clay Mask
description: A purifying clay mask with activated charcoal that draws out impurities and refines pores in 10 minutes.

name: Citrus Bloom Body Lotion
description: A fast-absorbing body lotion with notes of bergamot, neroli, and white musk. Leaves skin soft and lightly scented.

name: Onyx Eyeliner
description: A precision liquid eyeliner with a felt-tip applicator. Waterproof, smudge-proof, and intensely black.

name: Retinol Renewal Cream
description: An overnight retinol cream that smooths fine lines and resurfaces skin while you sleep. Formulated for sensitive skin.

name: Rose Petal Toner
description: An alcohol-free toner with real rose petal extract. Balances skin and prepares it for serum and moisturiser.

name: Solar Bronze Drops
description: Liquid bronzer drops that mix into foundation or moisturiser for a custom sun-kissed glow.

name: Vetiver & Smoke Cologne
description: An earthy unisex cologne with vetiver, smoked cedar, and a hint of bergamot. Cool, grounded, and modern.

name: Vitamin C Booster
description: A stabilised 15% vitamin C serum that brightens dull skin and evens tone with daily use.

name: Cashmere Blush
description: A silky powder blush in warm peach. Blends seamlessly for a soft, natural flush.

name: Sea Salt Hair Mist
description: A texturising mist that adds beachy waves and grip to any hair type. No stickiness, no crunch.

name: Argan Repair Oil
description: A nourishing hair oil with cold-pressed argan and jojoba. Tames frizz and adds shine without weighing hair down.

name: Velvet Rose Hand Cream
description: A rich hand cream with rose extract and shea. Absorbs quickly and leaves hands soft and lightly scented.

name: Iridescent Highlighter
description: A finely milled powder highlighter with a multi-dimensional pearl finish. Catches light from every angle.

name: Amber Rose Body Oil
description: A luxurious dry body oil with amber, rose, and almond. Sinks in instantly and leaves a subtle golden sheen.

name: Daily Mineral SPF 50
description: A weightless mineral sunscreen with zinc oxide. No white cast, no greasy feel — wears beautifully under makeup.

name: Bare Skin Tinted Balm
description: A sheer tinted balm that evens skin tone while hydrating. The barely-there alternative to foundation.
